# ToolsHub

> Free browser-based utility tools — image processing, PDF manipulation, generators, and more. All tools run entirely client-side using WebAssembly and AI models. No login, no ads, no server uploads. Your files never leave your device.

## What ToolsHub is

ToolsHub is a collection of 36+ privacy-focused browser utilities. Every tool processes files locally in the user's browser using WebAssembly, the Canvas API, and ONNX AI models — nothing is uploaded to any server.

- **Free, forever.** No freemium, no credits, no subscription.
- **Private by design.** Files stay on the user's device.
- **No account required.** Open a tool and start using it.
- **Works offline.** Once the page loads, most tools work without internet.

## Tool Categories

### Image Tools
- [Image Compressor](https://toolshub.app/image-compressor) — Compress JPG, PNG, WebP images in the browser. Adjustable quality, instant preview, batch supported.
- [Image Converter](https://toolshub.app/image-converter) — Convert between JPG, PNG, WebP in bulk. Download all as ZIP.
- [Image Resizer](https://toolshub.app/image-resizer) — Resize to exact dimensions or social media presets. Aspect ratio lock.
- [Image Cropper](https://toolshub.app/image-cropper) — Crop to any ratio (1:1, 4:3, 16:9, custom).
- [Background Remover](https://toolshub.app/background-remover) — AI-powered background removal using ONNX models. Runs entirely in-browser.
- [HEIC to JPG Converter](https://toolshub.app/heic-converter) — Convert iPhone HEIC photos to JPG, PNG, or WebP.
- [EXIF Stripper](https://toolshub.app/exif-stripper) — Remove GPS location and all metadata from photos before sharing.
- [Color Palette Generator](https://toolshub.app/color-palette) — Extract dominant colors from any image as HEX, RGB, HSL.
- [Color Picker](https://toolshub.app/color-picker) — Pick any color from an uploaded image. Eyedropper tool.
- [Video to GIF](https://toolshub.app/video-to-gif) — Convert MP4/WebM video clips to animated GIF.

### PDF Tools
- [PDF Tools](https://toolshub.app/pdf-converter) — 13 PDF utilities: compress, merge, split, protect, watermark, convert.
- [E-Signature](https://toolshub.app/e-signature) — Sign PDFs in-browser. Draw, type, or upload signature. No upload.
- [PDF Annotator](https://toolshub.app/pdf-annotator) — Highlight, draw, and annotate PDFs. Download with marks embedded.
- [OCR Tool](https://toolshub.app/ocr-tool) — Extract text from images using Tesseract.js. 8 languages including English and Hindi.

### Generator Tools
- [Password Generator](https://toolshub.app/password-generator) — Cryptographically secure passwords using the browser's Web Crypto API.
- [QR Code Generator](https://toolshub.app/qr-generator) — QR codes for URLs, text, WiFi, and contact cards. PNG/SVG download.
- [WhatsApp Link Generator](https://toolshub.app/whatsapp-link) — Create WhatsApp click-to-chat links with pre-filled messages.
- [Resume Builder](https://toolshub.app/resume-builder) — Build and download a PDF resume. Multiple templates, no account.

### Utility Tools
- [Unit Converter](https://toolshub.app/unit-converter) — Convert 20+ unit categories: length, weight, temperature, area, speed, data.
- [Word Counter](https://toolshub.app/word-counter) — Count words, characters, sentences, paragraphs, and reading time.
- [Text Cleaner](https://toolshub.app/text-cleaner) — Remove extra spaces, fix line breaks, strip HTML, convert case.
- [Pomodoro Timer](https://toolshub.app/pomodoro-timer) — Browser-based Pomodoro timer. Customizable work/break intervals.
- [BMI Calculator](https://toolshub.app/bmi-calculator) — Body Mass Index calculator. Metric and imperial. Category ranges.
- [EMI Calculator](https://toolshub.app/emi-calculator) — Loan EMI calculator with full amortization schedule.
- [Base64 Tool](https://toolshub.app/base64) — Encode/decode text and files to Base64. Data URI generation. JWT payload decoder.

## Technical Stack

- Frontend: React 19, Vite, Tailwind CSS
- Heavy processing: WebAssembly, ONNX Runtime Web, Tesseract.js
- AI models: @imgly/background-removal, Hugging Face Transformers
- PDF: pdf-lib, PDF.js
- No backend for tool processing — all client-side
